statements.status_notes: This CVE is only affecting installation on PowerPC architecture and even then is this CVE disputed because the OpenSSL security policy explicitly notes that any side channels which require same physical system to be detected are outside of the threat model for the software. The timing signal is so small that it is infeasible to be detected without having the attacking process running on the same physical system.

Fault injection based attacks are not within OpenSSLs threat model according to the security policy and this CVE is not treated as security bug by upstream: https://www.openssl.org/policies/general/security-policy.html
